title: Read-Only Governed Loop Orchestrator v1
summary: Compose the completed RTS asset, read-only evaluation, bounded execution-record, outcome-evidence, regression, and learning-proposal components into one deterministic repository-local one-shot loop that produces a reconstructable run record without external execution or mutation authority.
original_problem: RTS now has independently verified components for asset discovery, read-only evaluation, bounded execution records, governed outcomes, regression comparison, and learning proposals, but no single current contract links their exact fingerprints into one reproducible loop run.
why_it_matters: A read-only orchestrator can demonstrate end-to-end value, expose integration drift, and provide one reviewable run record before any scheduler, provider, adjacent-repository write, or Skill-application authority is considered.
reason_frozen: Integration could accidentally recreate hidden coupling or widen execution and mutation authority. A current BUILD_NOW Assessment, PASS Implementation Preflight, explicit human approval, and WIP=1 transition are required before implementation.
preserved_value: One-shot deterministic orchestration across the completed RTS child components.
Exact fingerprint linkage from observed assets through evaluation, execution record, outcome evidence, regression result, and learning proposal.
Immutable repository-local loop-run records with reconstructable inputs and outputs.
Fail-closed authority boundaries that preserve human approval and prohibit external side effects.
trigger_conditions: RTS-FRZ-000004 through RTS-FRZ-000007 are COMPLETED with current governed records.
RTS-FRZ-000003 has a current BUILD_NOW parent Assessment.
The orchestrator remains repository-local, one-shot, deterministic, and read-only.
A loop-run schema can pin exact component inputs and outputs without private content.
negative_triggers: Automatic scheduling, continuous polling, or unattended execution is introduced.
Network, provider, subprocess, shell, publication, deployment, messaging, or customer-action authority is added.
The orchestrator mutates a Skill, writes to an adjacent repository, or treats a proposal as approval.
Raw prompts, credentials, customer data, provider payloads, or private repository bodies are persisted.
Component verification is bypassed or fingerprints are accepted without recomputation.
possible_destinations: future human-reviewed Hermes Drive orchestration adapter
